title: Ancestral Living
subtitle: Eating and moving the way the body evolved for
lede: A reference to {videos} sources on ancestral movement and lifestyle — making daily life more aligned with how humans evolved to move.
about_paragraphs: A reference built from {videos} sources on natural movement and ancestral lifestyle practices — synthesised into {library_files} knowledge files and {glossary_terms} glossary terms.

Every claim traces to a specific point in a specific source — a video timestamp. Nothing here is generated: there is no model in this app, and it makes no network requests. It works offline, permanently.
catalog_description: Every transcript ingested into this knowledge package, with the subjects, movements, principles, and concepts each one covers.
